Hello team,

Quick update from Aurelia Skyways on the pet handoff for Starling. The onboard handler for the Starling is Bela Thorn. Please keep that detail tight in the workflow notes so the passenger team can answer cleanly and avoid any back-and-forth at the gate.

For the travelers, Yara Bianchi and Andre Larsen should still be guided through the usual steps before departure, with the animal record checked, crate condition confirmed, and the comfort plan aligned with onboard expectations. Stella is also set for normal care handling, so the focus is on steady communication and making sure every touchpoint is calm, clear, and on time.

If anything shifts, flag it fast and keep the message simple. Our job here is to protect the trip, reduce stress for the travelers, and make sure trained staff can give each animal patient attention from start to finish.

Customer Advocate Companion Animal Travel Desk
